_comment: Voice-input intent routing rules for the unified voice entry point (POST /api/v1/voice/route). Independent from chat_intent_rules.json (used only by /chat/respond) so tuning one never affects the other. priority_order is fixed by design and enforced as a cascade in voice_intent_router.py, not a max-score comparison.

reservation_recommendation._reservation_comment: 업종만 말하고 특정 업체명 없이 예약을 원할 때(예: '미용실 예약해줘')도 추천으로 라우팅. 아래 동사 중 하나 + 장소 카테고리(place_recommendation_rules의 category_aliases) 감지 시 발동.

emotion_schedule_coaching._comment: Fires only when BOTH an emotion word AND a schedule-reference word are present (spec 4-2) — a bare schedule query without emotion stays schedule_query.

schedule_query._comment: strong-only trigger — bare 'weak' hits (e.g. lone '일정') must never steal a schedule_create utterance like '병원 일정 추가해줘'.

reminder_setting._comment: Context-gated: requires_context_type must match the client-echoed last_action_context.type, otherwise this intent never fires (spec: bare '알려줘' alone must not be misclassified).
